comment.text: PARP1 G500 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Source observations include Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach; Gastric adenocarcinoma; Gastric tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting PARP1 residue G500 have been observed in gastric adenocarcinoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
